title: THIS Can’t Keep Going On Much Longer…
speaker: Click Capital host

macro_themes.view: Deepest long-bond sell-off in US history, with France ground zero; affects the US least thanks to reserve-currency status and stronger growth.
High yields reflect capital flowing to fast-growing AI equities rather than bonds threatening stocks; corporates and consumers locked in low fixed rates.
Tech/semis/Mag 7 at or near highs while dividend, REIT and blue-chip stocks get slammed as they compete with bond yields.
Next 6 months are among the strongest of the presidential cycle and indices trade under 20x forward earnings, so stocks are not expensive.
Soft jobs report (29k) cut October hike odds below 25%; expects a hold, December hike still possible.
Odds favor a Democratic sweep; admin may try to push gas prices and yields down and pump markets before the vote.

calls.reason: QQQ and semis hit new all-time highs; AI boom and earnings growth let big tech ignore high yields.
calls.quote: the Nasdaq 100 index itself, the triple Qs, also hit a brand new all-time high today as elevated bond yields don't seem to be affecting …

calls.reason: Strong seasonal window into/after midterms plus valuations under 20x forward earnings; sentiment near extreme fear (contrarian).
calls.quote: the following 6 months some of the strongest seasonal period of the presidential election cycle

calls.reason: Q3 deliveries 486,532 vs 451k est.; up ~5%; robotaxi launch and possible SpaceX merger excite the market.
calls.quote: I think this is a pretty good result for Tesla

calls.reason: Structural pressures (deficits, issuance, persistent inflation and growth, capital preferring AI equities) force bonds to offer higher yields.
calls.quote: bonds are naturally having to offer a higher yield to become more appealing to investors
